definitions.delta: after minus before; negative is faster
definitions.quantile: nearest rank ceil(p*n); p50 for n=2 is lower observation; p95 is maximum at n=2,3,5
definitions.first_meaningful: Runner outbound POST to first non-whitespace public text/tool-argument delta. Includes routing, network, queueing, reasoning, generation and delivery; not isolated model TTFT.
definitions.total_ms: Time to body exhaustion / completed measurement after terminal event
definitions.prompts: Synthetic prompt identity reconstructed with core.mjs promptFor; matched run_id/family/pair, runner, requested model/effort, arm, split and SSE request.
definitions.cache: Positive provider-reported cached_tokens substantiates cache use. Missing is unknown, not zero.
definitions.confidence: Descriptive low-N before/after comparison; load, time, generated/reasoning token counts and cache state are confounded. No causal regional or streaming-only effect, robust tail estimate, or tuned heldout claim.

excluded: Jev experiment and any future samples
scope.cost: Actual provider spend is not recorded in these rows; token usage is not an invoice. Attempt accounting predates any separate Jev experiment.

validation.origin_assertion_scope: Named cf-placement must match the runner hint; API ingress is checked separately against expected colo and Ray. Missing named placements and missing route origin are counted, never treated as successful origin assertions. Provider compute origin is not measured.

mixed_descriptive_groups.description: Descriptive mixture: three short and two long-prefix prompts, not a homogeneous latency population.
